name: One-Arm Pronated Dumbbell Triceps Extension
how_to:
Step 1: Setup and Starting Position
- Lie flat on a bench with a dumbbell in one hand.
- Hold the dumbbell with a pronated grip (palm facing forward).
- Extend your arm straight up, positioning the dumbbell above your shoulder.
- Keep your elbow stationary, with your upper arm perpendicular to the floor.
Step 2: Execution
1. Slowly lower the dumbbell by bending your elbow, bringing it toward the side of your head.
2. Keep your elbow in place while your forearm moves.
3. Lower the dumbbell until you feel a deep stretch in your triceps.
4. Pause briefly, then extend your arm back to the starting position.
5. Repeat for 8 to 12 reps, then switch arms. Complete 3 to 4 sets.
